Covariance matrix implied by a kernel

Source: R/evaluate.R
kernel_matrix.Rd

Covariance matrix implied by a kernel

Usage

kernel_matrix(kernel, tree, pars = NULL)

Arguments

kernel

A kernel, e.g. k_bm() + k_white().

tree

A phylo tree (or the output of tree_info()).

pars

Optional parameter values, as a list named by component id (see print(kernel)), e.g. list(lambda1 = list(sigma = 1, lambda = 0.3)). Unspecified values take the defaults of each component. For components with latent rates (k_relaxed(), k_rate_time()), a rate path is drawn from the prior unless supplied (z or lograte).

Value

An N x N covariance matrix with tip labels as dimnames.

Examples

tr <- ape::rcoal(10)
kernel_matrix(k_bm() + k_white(), tr)
#>           t4       t7       t5       t8      t10       t9       t6       t1
